summary: Iteration 3 (Task rework: users have department; requester & PIC selectable from registered users via searchable combobox stored as Person object with user_id; 'Tugas Baru' and edit are FULL PAGES /tasks/new and /tasks/:id/edit, not modals). Backend 29/29 pytest passed (including 2 new iter3 tests + department field on users). Frontend E2E full flow passed: btn-tambah-tugas navigates to /tasks/new full page (no dialog), requester combobox search 'Budi' picks Budi Santoso and preview shows department 'Operasional', PIC combobox picks Siti Aminah, 2 items added, task-level URL doc added, Simpan navigates to /tasks/<id> detail with Budi + Operasional/phone/email in Pemberi Tugas card and Siti Aminah in Detail card. Edit button navigates to /tasks/<id>/edit full page (no dialog); priority change to 'Tinggi' persisted after save.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/tasks.py POST /tasks honors client-provided id and returns 400 on duplicate (spec allows 409/400 — using 400 is acceptable and consistent with existing style).
update_task correctly preserves item done_at when a title-only edit is submitted with the existing items array (verified by new test test_edit_preserves_item_done_state).
routers/users.py stores department on create and allows update; list endpoint returns department/phone/email.
UserSelect.jsx: searchable combobox stores full Person object {user_id,name,department,phone,email} on selection — matches spec.
TaskForm.jsx: full page for both create and edit, pre-generates draftId so DocumentManager uploads can attach before initial save — good UX pattern.
TaskDetail.jsx edit btn now navigates instead of opening modal — TaskDialog removed as claimed.
test_credentials: admin@flowdesk.com / admin123; budi@flowdesk.com/budi12345; siti@flowdesk.com/siti12345; andi@flowdesk.com/andi12345 (verified via user list).
seed_data_creation: TEST_/E2E_ prefixed data cleaned up in pytest; frontend E2E leaves one task 'E2E_iter3_task_full' for manual inspection (safe to purge).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full page TaskForm at /tasks/new and /tasks/:id/edit is stable. UserSelect combobox uses data-testid={testid}-search + {testid}-option-<userId>. Broadcast returns wa_url + email_sent when requester has phone/email; SMTP unconfigured so external send is a no-op (acknowledged). Meeting action-item convert bug from iteration 1 (fresh action item lacks id) — not re-tested this iteration; check MeetingDetail.updateActionItems if it recurs.
rca of the issue: N/A — all iter3 acceptance criteria met.
